name: 警官と讃美歌(Z2 新Advanced・学習コーナー)

p_f5630c6ec1.sentence: Help came with personal questions, but prison politely closed the door.
p_f5630c6ec1.prev: He wanted three months on the Island: meals, walls, a bed.
p_f5630c6ec1.next: First, he would eat at a bright restaurant without paying.

p_5274735af7.prev: He ate beef, bread and pie, then said he couldn’t pay.
p_5274735af7.next: Instead, the waiters threw him into the street themselves.

p_b706545789.sentence: Friends called at the gate, and he dreamed of useful work.
p_b706545789.prev: Back then, he had a home, with roses outside.
p_b706545789.next: The music filled the quiet night around him.

p_b98187ed65.sentence: But the head waiter looked at his trousers first.
p_b98187ed65.prev: He would say he had no money and get arrested.
p_b98187ed65.next: Two strong hands sent him outside before his stomach could vote.

p_16e80f0c00.sentence: But the head waiter looked at his trousers first.
p_16e80f0c00.prev: He would say he had no money and get arrested.
p_16e80f0c00.next: Two strong hands sent him outside before his stomach could vote.

p_57d4cb4167.sentence: The officer thought criminals always ran away.
p_57d4cb4167.prev: “Maybe I did that,” he said when a policeman appeared.
p_57d4cb4167.next: He chased a man running for a car and ignored Soapy.

p_2f10114417.sentence: A cheaper restaurant let him in, even in those trousers.
p_2f10114417.prev: He chased a man running for a car and ignored Soapy.
p_2f10114417.next: He ate beef, bread and pie, then said he couldn’t pay.

p_8fae3b248a.sentence: He started back towards his bench.
p_8fae3b248a.prev: Of course, he hadn’t tried working recently.
p_8fae3b248a.next: Light shone from an old church window as he passed.

p_ade7912254.next: “You’ll spend three months on the Island,” the Magistrate told him in the Police Court the following morning.

p_6b02398516.sentence: He stood still and held the iron fence tightly.
p_6b02398516.prev: Someone inside was practising a church song on the organ.
p_6b02398516.next: He had heard this song beside his mother long ago.

p_a409737377.sentence: “You’ll spend three months on the Island,” the Magistrate told him in the Police Court the following morning.

p_e8426ca3f1.next: A dead leaf dropped onto Soapy’s lap in Madison Square.

p_cb1dc474e1.sentence: Outside a theatre, he worked hard at shouting nonsense and dancing.
p_cb1dc474e1.prev: A policeman nearby enjoyed the show and laughed.
p_cb1dc474e1.next: “Just a college boy having fun,” a policeman told someone passing.

p_f64223f9cc.sentence: The fur importer had once offered him a driver’s job.
p_f64223f9cc.prev: He could still do honest work.
p_f64223f9cc.next: Tomorrow, he would find the man and ask again.

p_145f53cf4e.prev: Someone inside was practising a church song on the organ.
